rawFindings.title: Incorrect indentation offset range in VariableDeclarator listener
rawFindings.explanation: The added line sets a desired offset range starting from tokenAfterOperator.range[1] to node.range[1], offset by 1 relative to tokenAfterOperator. This change modifies how the indentation offset is applied for the node's tokens after the operator. The previous code had this missing, likely causing some tokens to be under-indented. However, the new range starts at tokenAfterOperator.range[1], not tokenAfterOperator.range[0], which could cause incorrect application of offsets, especially if tokens
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the range start from tokenAfterOperator.range[1] to tokenAfterOperator.range[0] so that the offset applies to all tokens including the tokenAfterOperator itself, ensuring correct indentation.
